why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Check that you're allowed. Vana's terms ask you to confirm "You are at least eighteen (18) years of age" and exclude US citizens and residents, as well as anyone in a sanctioned country.
Open community.vana.org and choose "Log in or join". Sign-in runs through account.vana.org, Vana's account service, and asks for your email and linked accounts.
Do the tasks listed in Discord and inside the members area: Discord tasks, Vana events and apps built on Vana. Read what an app asks to see before you allow it.
Spend your XP on the rewards shown in the members area. Vana hasn't said publicly whether XP on a losing bid comes back, so check the rules there before you bid.
